title: Tai Family Associate Professor of Business Administration
bio: Overview In her current research, Professor Gallani draws on economic and sociological theories to analyze the design of incentive and performance management systems. She explores the effectiveness of monetary and non-monetary incentives, feedback systems, and types of performance measures. Her research spans across industries, but her more recent work exhibits a particular focus on healthcare provider organizations.
